head: A hidden text message can drop calls on Android phones
dek: A bug in Android lets one specially made text message, which never shows in your inbox, crash the phone's calling service and cut off calls, including emergency calls.
details: Security researcher Mark Blaszczyk showed it on Pixel and Samsung Galaxy phones; the code goes back to Android 12 (CVE-2026-58882, rated critical). He says the fix is in October's security updates for Android 14 to 17, and it's expected in Google's November security bulletin.
where: Android 12 and later; fixed in the latest security updates
means: Phones without recent security updates could have calls cut off by a message you never see. Phones that no longer get updates may stay exposed.
todo: Install the latest security update on your phone (in Settings, look for System or Software update), and check again in November.
